concrete_scene.heading: Worked fusion boundary: roots 7 and 9 still share one hidden cause
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: Two agreeing sensor channels with declared roots 7 and 9, a pairwise classifier, and a global common-cause review
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Count agreeing channels as independent evidence for a bounded observation use while preserving identity, calibration, clock, pose, dependence, hypothesis, consumer, and residual custody.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: Distinct roots count as two only inside the pair model; the same root pair is admitted without a global common cause and rejected when a hidden shared cause exists, so the root summary cannot decide the global case.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether sensor count or pairwise root diversity proves global independence; twelve same-summary/opposite-common-cause controls reject that compression.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The observation and downstream consumer owners retain unknown dependence, calibration, synchronization, environmental truth, active-sensing, and invalidation residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The model trusts every channel and dependence field; it does not discover a real cause, validate calibration, identify environmental truth, measure fusion quality, detect spoofing, or authorize physical action.

worked_trace.heading: Worked fusion boundary: roots 7 and 9 still share one hidden cause
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The finite model demonstrates pair classification, lifecycle custody, terminal invalidation, and information loss from pairwise dependence summaries; it establishes no sensor truth, causal independence, robustness, safety, or useful fusion.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The simpler baseline treats two agreeing modalities or distinct declared roots as two votes. The chapter keeps per-channel evidence and a global dependence residual because the same pair summary can hide a shared cause.
readable_claim: Two sensors that agree are not automatically two pieces of evidence. Their clocks, pose, calibration, environment, training, and attack surface may reduce apparent diversity to one shared cause.
normative_rule: Preserve channel-local hypotheses and dependence roots before fusion. Count agreement as additional evidence only for the named use and reviewed dependence model; disagreement stays plural, and a material identity, calibration, clock, pose, dependence, or environment change invalidates the observation receipt.

formal_binding.anchor: versioned observation contract binds the task and required evidence

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The worked fusion boundary states once that dependence roots and common-cause fields are authored rather than discovered from sensors.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Calibration, synchronization, pose, coverage, missingness, dependence, corruption, spoofing, fusion, active sensing, downstream authority, and physical-safety limits remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: Roots 7 and 9 and the opposite common-cause dispositions remain because they prove the information-loss point; complete mutation and theorem inventories remain in evidence surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The reader claim and operational rule separate the independence failure and admission rule from the full observation-contract bundle.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The finite-model limit is consolidated once while sensor, calibration, dependence, corruption, action, and safety boundaries remain explicit.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The adjacent-owner and observation-need tables remain because they distinguish consumers and evidence requirements rather than repeat status.

non_claims: The root-pair example does not identify a real environmental or attack cause.
The finite model does not establish calibration, robustness, useful fusion, physical safety, or action authority.
The editorial revision does not move chapter-core support or release state.
